title: tess-bls parameters, version 1
description: Box least squares (BLS) transit search on one TESS SPOC light curve. The worker keeps rows with QUALITY equal to 0 and finite, positive flux and error. It normalizes the flux, removes the trend with a Savitzky-Golay filter, and searches a period grid. The defaults are the fixed T01 settings.

x-method.implementation: lightkurve LightCurve.normalize and flatten, astropy.timeseries.BoxLeastSquares autopower
x-method.scientific_status: Provisional. Guided recovery of two known planets in TESS sector 2 only. Depth accuracy, completeness, and false-alarm rates are not validated. Trend removal changes transit depths.
x-method.known_deviation: astropy autoperiod can extend the period grid slightly past maximum_period. The worker records the actual grid bounds as diagnostics.

flux_column.description: SPOC flux column. pdcsap_flux has systematic-error correction. sap_flux is simple aperture photometry.

minimum_rows.description: The smallest number of retained rows that permits a search.

minimum_baseline_days.description: The shortest time span of retained rows that permits a search.

flatten.description: Trend removal with lightkurve flatten (Savitzky-Golay filter with iterative sigma clipping). It removes stellar and instrumental variation longer than the window, and it can reduce transit depth.

window_length.description: Filter window in cadences. It must be odd. At 120 s cadence, 1001 cadences is about 1.39 d.

break_tolerance.description: A gap longer than this number of cadences splits the series into separate filter segments.

niters.description: Number of sigma-clipping iterations for the trend fit.

sigma.description: Clipping threshold for the trend fit, in standard deviations.

maximum_period.description: Longest trial period. A transit needs at least two events in the series to define a period.

duration_days.description: Trial transit durations. Each must be shorter than minimum_period.

frequency_factor.description: Grid spacing factor for astropy autoperiod. A smaller value gives a finer grid and more trials.

oversample.description: Number of transit-time samples in each trial duration.

objective.description: likelihood: log-likelihood improvement of the box model. snr: signal-to-noise ratio of the depth.

maximum_grid_trials.description: Resource limit. The worker stops before the search when the period grid has more trials.
